content: Tem mɛn bɔnu yirusewɑ yɑ kuɑ Simɛɔn bwese kɛrɑɡiɑ. Yudɑbɑn temɑ mu kɑ beɡim sikerenɛ.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ mi, siyɑ Beri Sebɑ kɑ Sebɑ kɑ Mɔlɑdɑ,
kɑ Hɑsɑɑ Suɑli, kɑ Bɑlɑ kɑ Asɛmu,
kɑ Ɛlitolɑdi, kɑ Betuli kɑ Hɔɔmɑ,
kɑ Sikilɑɡi, kɑ Bɛti Mɑɑkɑbɔti kɑ Hɑsɑɑ Susɑ,
kɑ Bɛti Lebɑɔti, kɑ Sɑrusɛni. Si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ mi wusu wɔkurɑ itɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu,
Aini, kɑ Rimɔɔ, kɑ Etɛɛ, kɑ Asɑni, si mɑɑ wusu nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu,
n kɑ dɑ Bɑlɑti Beriɔ ye bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Rɑmɑti, Nɛɡɛbuɔ. Tem mɛ bɑ siɑ siɑ mi kpuro, mɛyɑ mu sɑɑ Simɛɔn bwese kɛrɑɡim.
Yudɑbɑn tem sukumɑ bɑ Simɛɔn bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃, domi Yudɑbɑɡim mɛ, mu kpɑ̃.
Tem mɛ bɑ Sɑbulonin
bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃
Sɑbulonin bwese kɛrɑ yɑ Kɑnɑnin tem bɔnu itɑse tɛtɛ di. Ben tem mɛ, mu dɑwɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ sere Sɑridiɔ.
Sɑɑ mɑɑ min di mu dɑ mu nɔɔ yɔ̃rɑwɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ Mɑreɑlɑɔ kɑ Dɑbesɛtiɔ sere dɑru kokɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yokunɛɑmun sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ.
Sɑridin berɑ ɡiɑ mɑɑ tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ dɑwɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ sere Kisilɔti Tɑboriɔ, n kɑ ɡirɑri Dɑbɑrɑtiɔ kɑ Yɑfiɑɔ.
Min di tɑ dɑ Gitɑ Efɛɛɔ kɑ Itɑ Kɑsiniɔ n kɑ dɑ Rimɔɔwɔ sere Nɛɑ ɡiɑ.
Mɑ tɑ dɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ sere Hɑnɑtoni ɡiɑ n kɑ ɡirɑri Yifutɑ Elin wɔwɑɔ.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wusu wɔkurɑ yiru, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu. Sin ɡɑsɑ, Kɑtɑti kɑ Nɑhɑlɑli kɑ Simuroni kɑ Yideɑlɑ kɑ Bɛtelehɛmu.
Berɑ yeni kpurowɑ yɑ kuɑ Sɑbulonin bwese kɛrɑɡiɑ.
Tem mɛ bɑ Isɑkɑrin
bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃
Isɑkɑrin bwese kɛrɑ yɑ mɑɑ Kɑnɑnin tem mɛn bɔnu nnɛse tɛtɛ di.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ ye sɔɔ, siyɑ Yisirɛɛli kɑ Kesulɔtu kɑ Sunɛmu,
kɑ Hɑfɑrɑimu, kɑ Siɔni, kɑ Anɑsɑrɑti,
kɑ Rɑbiti, kɑ Kisioni, kɑ Abɛsi,
kɑ Remɛti, kɑ Eni Gɑnimu, kɑ Eni Hɑdɑ, kɑ Bɛti Pɑsɛsi.
Mɑ tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ mɑɑ dɑ Tɑboriɔ kɑ Sɑkɑsimɑɔ kɑ Bɛti Semɛsiɔ n kɑ ɡirɑri dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛniɔ. Wusu wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ su sɑ̃ɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Berɑ ye kpurowɑ yɑ kuɑ Isɑkɑrin bwese kɛrɑɡiɑ ye bɑ wɑ bɔnu sɔɔ.
Tem mɛ bɑ Asɛɛn bwese kɛrɑ
wɛ̃
Asɛɛn bwese kɛrɑ yɑ mɑɑ Kɑnɑnin tem mɛn bɔnu nɔɔbuse tɛtɛ di.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ mi, siyɑ Hɛlikɑti, kɑ Hɑli, kɑ Betɛni, kɑ Akusɑfu,
kɑ Alɑmɛlɛki, kɑ Amɛɑdi, kɑ Mikɑli. Tem mɛn sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ, mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑɑ Kɑɑmɛlin ɡuurun di n kɑ ɡirɑri dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Sikori Libinɑtiɔ.
Sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ mɑɑ, tɑ dɑwɑ sɑɑ Bɛti Dɑɡonin di n kɑ Sɑbulonin bwese kɛrɑn tem ɡirɑri sere wɔwɑɔ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Yifutɑ Eliɔ, mɑ tɑ dɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ Bɛti Emɛkiɔ kɑ Nɛyɛliɔ, kɑ Kɑbuluɔ,
kɑ Abudoniɔ kɑ Rehɔbuɔ kɑ Hɑmɔɔwɔ kɑ Kɑnɑɔ. Mɑ tɑ yɔ̃rɑ wuu bɔkɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Sidoniɔ.
Min di tɑ mɑɑ dɑ Rɑmɑ ɡiɑ kɑ sere Tiriɔ, wuu ɡe bɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru koosi, sere n kɑ ɡirɑri Hosɑɔ mɑ tɑ yɔ̃rɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛɔ, Akisibun berɑɔ.
Wuu siniwɑ su mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ. Siyɑ Umɑ kɑ Afɛki kɑ Rehɔbu. Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ, su sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɛndɑ yiru, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Berɑ ye kpurowɑ yɑ kuɑ Asɛɛn bwese kɛrɑɡiɑ ye bɑ wɑ bɔnu sɔɔ.
Tem mɛ bɑ Nɛfitɑlin
bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃
Nɛfitɑlin bwese kɛrɑ yɑ mɑɑ Kɑnɑnin tem bɔnu nɔɔbɑ tiɑse tɛtɛ di.
Sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Helɛfun di sere Sɑnɑnimun dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔwɔ n kɑ ɡirɑri Adɑmi Nɛkɛbuɔ kɑ Yɑbunɛɛliɔ kɑ Lɑkumuɔ, mɑ tɑ yɔ̃rɑ Yuudɛniɔ.

Sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ mɑɑ, tem mɛ, mu nɔɔ yɔ̃rɑwɑ Asinɔtu Tɑboriɔ kɑ Hukɔkuɔ n dɑ n Sɑbulonin bwese kɛrɑn tem bɛwɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ n kɑ ɡirɑri Asɛɛn bwese kɛrɑn temɔ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ. Sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛni tɑ kuɑ mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru.
Ben tem mɛ sɔɔ, wuu si su ɡbɑ̃rɑru mɔ wee, Sidimu kɑ Seri kɑ Hɑmɑti kɑ Rɑkɑti kɑ Kinɛrɛti,
kɑ Adɑmɑ kɑ Rɑmɑ kɑ Hɑsori
kɑ Kedɛsi kɑ Edɛɛ kɑ Eni Hɑsori,
kɑ Yireoni kɑ Miɡidɑli Eli, kɑ Horɛmu, kɑ Bɛti Anɑti kɑ Bɛti Semɛsi. Wuu si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɛndu tiɑ sɑri, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Berɑ ye kpurowɑ yɑ kuɑ Nɛfitɑlin bwese kɛrɑɡiɑ ye bɑ wɑ bɔnu sɔɔ.
Tem mɛ bɑ Dɑnun
bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃
Dɑnun bwese kɛrɑ yɑ mɑɑ Kɑnɑnin tem mɛn bɔnu nɔɔbɑ yiruse tɛtɛ di.
Wuu si su mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben tem mɛ sɔɔ, siyɑ Soreɑ kɑ Ɛsitɑoli kɑ Yiri Semɛsi,
kɑ Sɑlɑbini, kɑ Ayɑloni kɑ Yitilɑ,
kɑ Eloni kɑ Tinnɑtɑ, kɑ Ekoroni,
kɑ Ɛliteke, kɑ Gibetoni kɑ Bɑlɑti,
kɑ Yehudi, kɑ Bɛnɛ Berɑki, kɑ Gɑti Rimɔɔ,
kɑ Yɑɑkonin dɑɑru kɑ Rɑkoni, kɑ Yɑfon berɑ.

Sɑnɑm mɛ Dɑnubɑ bɑ wɑ yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ kpɑm ben tem mwɛɛrimɔ, yerɑ be, bɑ mɑɑ dɑ bɑ Lesɛmu wɔri bɑ yen tɔmbu kpuro ɡo. Mɑ bɑ yɑnde sinɑ mi, yɑ kuɑ ben wuu. Yerɑ bɑ ye ben sikɑdon yĩsiru kɑ̃ te bɑ mɔ̀ Dɑnu.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ mi kpuro su kuɑwɑ beɡisu kɑ sin bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Isirelibɑ bɑ tem mɛ bɔnu kuɑ bɑ kpɑ, yen biruwɑ bɑ Yosue Nunin bii wiɡim wɛ̃.
Wiyɑ bɑ wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Tinnɑti Serɑki wɛ̃ ye u bikiɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. Wuu ɡerɑ ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑimun ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ. Mɑ u ɡu bɑnɑ sɔnwɑ u sinɑ mi.

Yɑ̃ku kowo Eleɑsɑɑ kɑ Yosue Nunin bii kɑ sere mɑɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛrin wiruɡibɑ bɑ Kɑnɑnin tem mɛ kpuro bɔnu kuɑ kɑ tɛtɛ Siloɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔwɔ. Mɑ bɑ bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyere wɛ̃ bɔnu ye yɑ tɛtɛ di. Mɛsumɑ bɑ kɑ tem mɛ bɔnu kuɑ.
Wuu sìn mi bɑ rɑ kpikiru de
